<noinclude>
Lists the chronicles and events in which the current page (character, place, artifact, faction) appears, from the Cargo tables. Place under <code>== Appearances ==</code>.

Optional: <code>|page=Other title</code> to query for a different page.
[[Category:Query templates]]
</noinclude><includeonly><div class="wst-appearances">{{#cargo_query:tables=Chronicles
|fields=_pageName=Chronicle,_pageTitle=Label,era=Era
|where=characters HOLDS "{{{page|{{PAGENAME}}}}}" OR pov HOLDS "{{{page|{{PAGENAME}}}}}" OR locations HOLDS "{{{page|{{PAGENAME}}}}}" OR events HOLDS "{{{page|{{PAGENAME}}}}}"
|order by=sequence,_pageName
|format=template|template=Appearances/row|named args=yes
|intro=<div class="wst-appearances-group"><div class="wst-appearances-label">Chroniken</div><ul class="wst-appearances-list">
|outro=</ul></div>
|default=
}}{{#cargo_query:tables=Events
|fields=_pageName=Chronicle,_pageTitle=Label,date=Status,era=Era
|where=participants HOLDS "{{{page|{{PAGENAME}}}}}" OR location HOLDS "{{{page|{{PAGENAME}}}}}" OR factions HOLDS "{{{page|{{PAGENAME}}}}}" OR side1 HOLDS "{{{page|{{PAGENAME}}}}}" OR side2 HOLDS "{{{page|{{PAGENAME}}}}}" OR commanders1 HOLDS "{{{page|{{PAGENAME}}}}}" OR commanders2 HOLDS "{{{page|{{PAGENAME}}}}}"
|order by=year_start,_pageName
|format=template|template=Appearances/row|named args=yes
|intro=<div class="wst-appearances-group"><div class="wst-appearances-label">Begebenheiten</div><ul class="wst-appearances-list">
|outro=</ul></div>
|default=
}}</div></includeonly>
